edits.before: Q a vital and back out — free chip he cannot answer. Identify how Neeko contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neeko cannot stop you walking her down: Q her Vital, take the chip, and hold Riposte for her Tangle-Barbs root instead.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Tangle-Barbs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your Lunge resets off Vitals out-pace her Blooming Burst poke — engage the moment Tangle-Barbs is down; it is 12s at rank 1.

edits.before: Grand Challenge paints four vitals and the heal field wins any committed duel. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Neeko's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grand Challenge paints four vitals and the heal field wins the all-in. Pop Blossom hangs in the air before it stuns — walk out of the landing zone.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Neeko carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: You still win the straight 1v1, but a disguised Neeko picks people off in fog — never facecheck brush near objectives.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: matchup-defining — Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs: 12s at rank 1 — her only lane CC. Parry it and the root returns as a stun. - Pop Blossom: 120s at rank 1, and it hangs in the air before landing — step out. - Blooming Burst is 9s poke; sustain it, do not spend W.

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Neeko, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Neeko, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until her bar forces the all-in she loses.
